title: Capybara fossil found in one of the driest places on Earth
description: A fossil capybara tooth shows Chile’s Atacama once had wetter habitats capable of supporting water-dependent animals millions ago.

title: Ancient Sulawesi Teeth Suggest Hunter-Gatherers Used a Psychoactive Nut Up to 25,000 Years Ago
description: Tooth wear and arecoline traces in two Sulawesi foragers suggest betel nut use began up to 25,000 years ago, possibly the oldest known habitual drug use.
